body:
SLICE B CHECK-IN — probe shape copied after A posted it. I chose a single validated non-case value for each core atlas, with field-level checked constructor of(source, units) / of(atlas, turns, speakers), rather than a phantom Unchecked state. Reason: these core types have no legitimate domain operation on an invalid aggregate; the unchecked representation is already the raw fields arriving from analysis, tests, and codecs. Exposing an Unchecked atlas would preserve exactly the invalid asserted type Article IV forbids. This follows the existing ClaimMeta pattern: private bare constructor, checked of, validating unsafe for static fixtures, structural equality/hash, intentional non-payload toString, and validated(existing) retained only for recursive aggregate validators. Codecs now construct from decoded fields through of; invalid tests pass raw modified fields to of.

Evidence so far: pre-fix disposable external forge suite passed 1/1 and minted duplicate-unit SurfaceAtlas plus duplicate-turn TranscriptAtlas through public copy, both subsequently rejected. After fix, clean-recompiled external probe package has same-module case-class fromProduct controls, refuses fromProduct/copy for both atlas types, preserves public reads, and exercises runtime rejection through each smart constructor: 7/7. Focused Atlas/Splitter/Quote/Transcript runtime suites: 29/29. Combined clean gate: 36/36. No commit yet; next is full reference-scope JVM gate, diff audit, candidate commit, then exact-SHA cross-platform gate.
